keyEvents.text: Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 1, Union Berlin 0. Equi Fernández (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Miguel Gutiérrez.
Felix Uduokhai (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.

Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 2, Union Berlin 0. Facundo Medina (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Miguel Gutiérrez with a cross following a corner.
Zeno Van den Bosch (Union Berlin) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
keyEvents.shortText: Zeno Van Den Bosch Yellow Card

keyEvents.text: Goal! Bayer 04 Leverkusen 3, Union Berlin 0. Patrik Schick (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Jarell Quansah with a cross.
Miguel Gutiérrez (Bayer 04 Leverkusen) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Tim Skarke replaces Emmanuel Latte Lath.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Woo-yeong Jeong replaces Michel Aebischer.
Substitution, Union Berlin. Janik Haberer replaces Aljoscha Kemlein.

Substitution, Bayer 04 Leverkusen. Christian Kofane replaces Patrik Schick.
